source_caption:
To bring his long-awaited passion project to life, director Guillermo del Toro relied heavily on massive practical sets and intricate character design. Despite the vast, frozen scale of the Arctic “Farthest North” sequences, the scenes were actually filmed in a Netflix studio parking lot in Toronto, where production designers built giant Styrofoam icebergs and a 130-foot-long ship mounted on a massive roller gimbal. For the Creature, Jacob Elordi wore 42 individual prosthetic pieces designed to resemble both classical marble statues and Crimean War casualties, creating what del Toro envisioned as a “beautiful monster”. To shape the Creature’s emotional softness and innocent physicality, Elordi actually studied the movements of his own golden retriever, grounding the terrifying resurrected soldier with a surprising sense of canine vulnerability.

Frankenstein (2025), directed by Guillermo del Toro, starring Oscar Isaac, Jacob Elordi, Mia Goth, Christoph Waltz. An arrogant surgeon obsessed with curing death fashions a body from battlefield casualties and accidentally brings a powerful, misunderstood creature to life, leading to a tragic, globe-spanning confrontation between the creator and his creation.

source_details.title: Frankenstein
source_details.synopsis: Frankenstein is a 2025 American science fiction horror film produced, written, and directed by Guillermo del Toro, based on the 1818 novel by Mary Shelley. The Gothic film stars Oscar Isaac as Victor Frankenstein and Jacob Elordi as the Creature, with Mia Goth and Christoph Waltz in supporting roles. The story follows the life of Frankenstein, an egotistical scientist whose experiment in creating new life results in dangerous consequences. Del Toro had long imagined a faithful Frankenstein film as a "dream project".
